evidence.name: Analytics setup
evidence.userNeed: Configure analytics before traffic so visits, screen events, and checkout transitions are measured from the first run.

sections.title: Track the funnel before scaling
sections.description: Set up and verify analytics before publishing to traffic. Events are measured from the first visitor, so a destination added later cannot capture earlier sessions.

sections.title: Choose the provider, then verify
sections.description: Pick the analytics platform that matches your reporting workflow, then publish a test funnel and confirm events arrive in that provider dashboard within seconds.

sections.title: Enable GDPR consent management (optional)
sections.description: Toggle consent management to show a consent banner in regulated regions. You set the default consent state, banner text, and privacy policy URL, and consent decisions gate which events are collected.
